items.back: Bank holiday by decree. Mechanism: an authority closes a whole class of exits, and the closure only works if nobody is told beforehand, because the telling would be the cue to run; so the door is locked in the hours the holder cannot reach it. Greece's banks stayed shut on Monday 29 June 2015 after a Sunday-night broadcast. Cyprus declared a bank holiday in March 2013 and kept extending it, after parliament voted down the first levy, until the bail-in was on the statute book. Argentina's corralito was announced on a Saturday in December 2001. Export-licence suspensions and delistings are gazetted after they have taken effect. Condition lost: a permission, the leave to move what is yours. Carrier: the authority's own calendar, set to Friday evening and the public holiday. Threshold: the decree itself; there is no earlier line. Tell: this is the one expiry on the map whose notice cannot precede it, so a holder waiting for a date is waiting for something the mechanism forbids. Changed next move: the only preserving act was a transfer made on rumour alone, paid for by the chance of being wrong and the discount the rumour market charges; the deposits that left Greece that spring left on nothing firmer. Adds to runway-illusions' Cash behind glass (the deposit put into receivership on a Friday, owned and out of reach) the mechanism that picked the Friday. Not investor-tells' Let it lapse, a fuse the founder can test by letting it burn, since a closure that can be probed need not arrive as a surprise; not a withdrawn offer or a rival's foreclosure, which someone at the holder's table decides, since the decree rules on a class and nobody at the holder's table decided anything about the holder. No claim that the exit dies as a by-product: the decree names the exit and forbids it.

Bar date in the newspaper. Mechanism: the claim runs out on a date fixed in a proceeding the holder is not in the room for, and the law presumes the holder read it. The bankruptcy court sets a bar date for proofs of claim and notices unknown creditors by publication; the class settlement's opt-out deadline arrives on a postcard indistinguishable from junk mail; the probate creditor's window opens and shuts once the notice has run in the county paper. Condition lost: a permission, the standing to be paid or to sue on one's own account. Carrier: the bar-date order joined to the rule of constructive notice, under which publication counts as knowledge for everyone the debtor could not name. Threshold: the docket date, imputed to the holder. Tell: the holder who would file is, by definition, the one nobody told. Changed next move: a one-page proof of claim or a signed opt-out, the cheapest filing the law knows and the one least often made. Adds to runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, a permission whose date the holder can read on the stamp, the date written on someone else's docket and imputed to the holder. Not deal-deaths' Missing witness: nothing is missing from the record, only the holder from the room.

Parent instrument lapses. Mechanism: the option was issued under a parent paper with a term of its own, so it ends when the parent ends, on its own merits or none, and the grant itself prints no date. The emergency-use authorization ends when the declaration it was issued under is terminated, a separate paper from the public-health emergency that ended in May 2023 and left the authorizations standing; cross-state telehealth licences lapsed as each state's emergency lapsed through 2021 and 2022; the wartime power, the pilot run under a waiver, the sub-lease that dies with the head lease. Condition lost: a permission. Carrier: the parent instrument's date, which the holder never signed and may never have read. Threshold: the parent's termination, wherever that is written. Tell: the grant the holder did read carries no date, so the first job is to find which parent paper carries the term. Changed next move: conversion, filed while the parent still stands: full approval, a permanent rule, a licence in the holder's own name. Conversion is slow enough that it must be started while the emergency looks endless, which is exactly when nobody starts it. Not Bar date in the newspaper, where the date sits on a docket and is imputed, since here it sits on a different paper from the option and is honest; not lead-time-floors' Calendar with nothing in it, a wait the rule imposes, since here the rule does not wait but ends.

Patch before seven. Mechanism: the option expires on the holder's own developmental timetable, which the holder cannot know, so the last intervention is necessarily in someone else's hand. Amblyopia is most correctable by patching the good eye in the first years of life and responds less, and less completely, after about seven, though the trials of the 2000s found response into the early teens; the clubfoot is cast in infancy; the second language acquired without an accent, disputed as a hard window; the duckling imprinting on its first day. Condition lost: a capability, the cortex's willingness to rewire. Carrier: the developmental schedule. Threshold: about seven for occlusion, with a tail into the early teens. Tell: the holder is a child who does not know there is an eye at stake, so the option belongs to one person and its preservation to another. Changed next move: screening, the preschool vision check and the parent who notices a squint; where no screening programme exists, the option expires unseen at a rate that belongs to the programme, not the child. Adds to Last known well, where a witness dates the option, the case in which the holder cannot be its own witness at all. Not a use-it-or-lose-it: nothing the child does or fails to do runs the clock.

Last known well. Mechanism: the option is dated by the last person who saw the fact, not by the fact, so it expires when the proof runs out while the tissue might still permit it. The stroke patient who wakes with the deficit is ineligible for thrombolysis because the four-and-a-half-hour window counts from when she was last seen well, which was bedtime, so the wake-up stroke loses the drug no matter when the artery actually closed; the same rule governs the opened vial with no time on the label and the sample with a gap in its chain of custody, both treated as expired at the earliest moment they could have been. Condition lost: a capability, a treatment the protocol now forbids. Carrier: the protocol's timestamp rule, which asks for a witness and not for the tissue. Threshold: the window counted from the last witnessed moment, not the actual onset. Tell: the record's clock has run when the body's may not have. Changed next move: a witness: someone awake, a time written on the vial, or a witness of another kind, the imaging that reads the tissue's own clock, by which the WAKE-UP trial of 2018 gave the drug back to patients with no witnessed onset. Adds to witness-architectures, which asks what has to exist for a trace to form, the option that dies for lack of a trace while the fact would still allow it. Not Patch before seven, where the body's own clock has run.

Moot before ruling. Mechanism: the option to have a decision expires because the situation resolves faster than the forum can move, so nobody declines and nobody rules. The student's challenge to a law school's admissions was dismissed as moot because he was about to graduate (DeFunis, 1974); the pregnancy is over before the appeal; the election is held before the ballot-access case; the tenant is evicted before housing court sits; the grievance is mooted by the reorganization that abolished the post. Condition lost: a permission, the justiciability of the claim. Carrier: the ratio of the forum's pace to the harm's duration, a number nobody at the table sets. Threshold: the harm ends before the forum reaches it. Tell: there is no date anywhere, and nothing is eaten along a curve; the harm is simply over. Changed next move: a structure that outlives the individual harm, never hurrying: the class certified before the named plaintiff's harm ends, which Sosna (1975) allowed, or the doctrine that a harm capable of repetition yet evading review can be decided anyway, which Roe rested on; the option is kept by a coordination or a rule. Not deal-deaths' Cost of the last mile, where the surplus is eaten along a curve; not Bar date in the newspaper, since there is no date.

Session ends. Mechanism: the body that could have said yes reaches the end of its own term with the matter still pending, and its successor never has to say no, because the matter restarts from zero. Bills die on adjournment sine die and must be reintroduced from scratch; the treaty is signed and waits on a parliament that is dissolved; the permit application sits before a council that is re-elected; the approval the old board agreed in the hallway and had not minuted when the board was reconstituted; the offer approved by a committee disbanded in the reorganization. Condition lost: a counterparty, the specific body whose yes was on offer; what expires is the matter's place in the process. Carrier: the ratifier's own calendar, its election, session, or term. Threshold: adjournment, dissolution, reconstitution. Tell: the successor starts the matter from zero with no recorded no. Changed next move: the vote scheduled before adjournment, the carry-over motion, the approval minuted rather than agreed in the hallway. The treaty cases are simplified, since most unratified treaties were eventually refused by someone; the clean form is the legislative bill, which dies by the thousand every session. Adds to deal-deaths' Ratifier's other deal, where the ratifier wanted a different bargain, the ratifier that wanted this one and was gone before the vote. Not Landlord changes, where the counterparty is replaced by transfer, since here it is replaced by the calendar.

Landlord changes. Mechanism: an option held in a person rather than on the paper that transfers expires at the counterparty's next transfer, which the holder neither controls nor, often, sees. The landlord who promised the renewal sells to a buyer not bound by unrecorded promises; the 'we'll take you back' comes from a manager who leaves; the side letter with a fund's partner has never been seen by the successor manager; the supplier's verbal priority vanishes with the account executive. Condition lost: a counterparty, the one whose word held the option. Carrier: the register, the deed, the fund agreement, the offer letter on letterhead, none of which ever had the option written on it, so the successor takes free of it. Threshold: the transfer. Tell: the promise lives in a person, not on the instrument that binds successors. Changed next move: recording: a memorandum of option on the title, a side letter countersigned by the entity, the promise put onto the paper that binds successors, at the cost of asking a friendly counterparty to bind their unknown replacement. Adds to term-sheet-powers' Successor in the chair, where the replacement exercises a term the friend would not have, the mirror case, in which the replacement declines to honour a term the friend gave. Not Chair grown over, where the counterparty stays and the shape goes.

Chair grown over. Mechanism: the option to return rests on a vacancy the counterparty has not yet re-planned, so it expires at the counterparty's next planning cycle with nobody declining the return. The leave with no return date whose post is split among three people at the next reorganization; the budget line reallocated at year end; the supplier's line retooled for the customer who stayed; the co-founder's seat the remaining founders stop leaving empty at the next hire. Condition lost: a capability on the counterparty's side, the shape that could receive the holder; what expires is the return to the seat, since employment there afterwards is a fresh negotiation from outside. Carrier: the counterparty's planning cadence, quarterly, annual, the next reorganization, set with no reference to the holder. Threshold: the cycle turning. Tell: nobody opposes the return; the absence is simply absorbed. Changed next move: a dated return, a leave rather than a resignation, a reservation the cycle has to respect, or the return itself before the cycle turns. Adds to traces-of-the-unlived's Vacancy tenant, where preparing for a future breeds its opponents, the case with no opponents. Not forms-of-return's Reentry burn, a road open and hostile one way, since this road has closed.

Signatures past sixty days. Mechanism: an option that needs many simultaneous yeses expires unless the gathering outruns the decay of each yes, so a coordination has a half-life. The recall petition whose signatures older than sixty days are void under Michigan's rule, or which must all fall inside California's hundred and sixty days; the tender offer's minimum condition that must be met by the offer's expiry; the crowd in the square that goes home; the reunion that becomes impossible one death at a time. Condition lost: a coordination. Carrier: the validity window on each act of assent, written by the rule or by the assenter's own attention span. Threshold: the point at which yeses expire faster than they are gathered. Tell: many small calendars kill the matter, not one body's. Changed next move: a gathering rate: paid circulators, a date agreed in advance, a pact that binds the early yeses until the last arrives. The recall and tender cases are observed; the crowd is analogy. Adds to who-can-be-bound's Place in line, an ordering lost by leaving, the coordination lost by others' leaving. Not Session ends, where one body's calendar kills the matter.

Priced past the acquirer. Mechanism: the holder's own growth carries the counterparty out of reach, so the option to sell to the natural acquirer expires at the round that prices the company above what the acquirer can pay at all: a market capitalization smaller than the price, a wage cap, a fund's concentration limit, and past those a board's approval ceiling, with nobody at either table declining. The company whose preference stack now exceeds the largest deal any of its three strategic buyers has ever done; the player whose wage outgrows every club in the league but two; the practice too large for any partner to buy into and too small to list. Condition lost: a counterparty, the buyer whose capacity was the option. Carrier: the acquirer's capacity, legible in its market value and deal history, set against the holder's own price, which every round raises. Threshold: the round that crosses the ceiling. Tell: the counterparty is unchanged; the holder has left its range. Changed next move: the sale at the last price under the ceiling, never seen as the last, or a round sized to stay under it, the one choice a founder is never advised to make. Analytical, since every observed case can be read as a buyer that would have paid more; the item stands as a mechanism, not a count. Adds to market-deaths' Slowed past the rot, where a market thins from outside, the market the holder thins by growing. Not Chair grown over, where the counterparty re-plans.

Pour the foundation. Mechanism: a permission is about to be withdrawn by a third party's change of rule, and can be kept only by an act in the world that no filing substitutes for. The building may proceed under the old zoning only if the developer has substantially begun in reliance on a valid permit before the ordinance passes, the footings poured the week of the council vote; the nonconforming use survives the new code only if actually in use on the effective date; the grandfathered rate is kept only by the account that was open. Condition lost: a permission. Carrier: the code together with the vested-rights doctrine, which in most states vests on construction begun and in a few, Washington among them, on a complete application. Threshold: the effective date of the new rule. Tell: the last act differs by jurisdiction, and the holder who knows which one has a different week. Changed next move: the hole in the ground before the vote, an exercise begun rather than a filing made, so the option is preserved only by starting to use it, and one beginning vests it for good. Adds to first-mover-forecloses, which holds the rival who changes the rules on purpose, the rule that changes for reasons of its own. Not Slot flown empty, where the exercise must be repeated to keep the right.

Slot flown empty. Mechanism: the permission expires by disuse and is kept only by exercise, so the clock runs while the holder does nothing and stops when the holder acts, and the preserving act is the exercise stripped of its purpose. The airport slot must be flown eighty percent of the season or handed back, which had airlines flying empty aircraft in early 2020 until the rule was waived; the water right under prior appropriation is forfeited after five years without beneficial use, which has fields irrigated in a drought to keep them; the trade mark is abandoned after three years' non-use; the mining claim is kept by annual labour; the department budget is spent in the last quarter so it is not cut. Condition lost: a permission. Carrier: the regulator's usage ledger. Threshold: eighty percent of the season, five years, three years, the annual labour, the fiscal year. Tell: no act ever finishes the keeping. Changed next move: the empty flight, which costs the full price of using the option and returns nothing but the option, so keeping and using become one act and the option's upkeep is its exercise price. Adds to runway-illusions' Stamp's clock, whose licence lapses without hours logged and whose clock no cash extends, the price at which it can be extended after all: the hours flown for nobody. Adds to tollgates-that-must-buy's Stamp with an expiry, where the gate must spend its stamp, the permission-holder who must burn the permission to keep it; and to power-trades' Leased strike, where disuse makes a power unbelieved, the disuse that forfeits it by rule. Not Pour the foundation, one act that vests.

Thawed to be ready. Mechanism: preparing to exercise the option starts a decay the unprepared state did not have, so the option to wait expires because the option to act was made ready. The vaccine vial keeps for months frozen, for weeks once thawed, for hours once punctured; the epoxy's pot life begins at mixing; the drawn dose; the armed fuze; the reagent brought to room temperature; the opened surgical field; the reserve army that cannot be held at the frontier through the harvest it was drawn from. Condition lost: a capability, the good itself, spoiling in its ready state. Carrier: a chemistry, or a season, that starts at preparation. Threshold: months frozen, weeks thawed, hours punctured; the pot life; the harvest. Tell: the harm falls on the good, not the holder; the option dies of being touched. Changed next move: not preparing, or preparing in the smallest unit, the single-dose vial, the small mix, the tranche thawed for the day's bookings; the clinic that thaws a whole tray to be sure of serving whoever walks in has bought readiness with the doses it will throw away at closing. The mirror of Slot flown empty, where the option dies of not being touched; a holder who holds both must burn the one and refrain from readying the other. Not lead-time-floors' Understudy, a finished copy waiting, since the understudy does not spoil for having been rehearsed; not Kept on the machine, where the harm falls on the holder and is billed by the day.

Waived by the first response. Mechanism: the option must be taken before any other move on a linked matter, so its clock is the holder's own next act rather than a date; a holder who does nothing keeps it, a holder who does anything adjacent loses it. The objection to the court's jurisdiction over the defendant is waived if omitted from the first response; the patent is dead in Europe on the morning of the conference talk and a year later in the United States; the appeal is waived by taking the settlement; the election of remedies; the defect in the goods that must be objected to before the goods are used; the 'speak now' at the wedding. Condition lost: a permission. Carrier: a rule that ties the option to a position in a sequence, and the sequence is written somewhere other than the option, in the rules of procedure, the patent statute, the sales code. Threshold: the first adjacent move. Tell: the holder learns the order from the loss; there is no date, and the holder is the only one who can strike. Changed next move: the ordering itself: the provisional application filed the morning of the talk, the reservation written into the first filing, the objection lodged before the goods are unpacked, each costing nothing but the knowledge that an order exists. Not Slot flown empty, where inaction runs the clock, since here inaction is the only thing that keeps it; not Bar date in the newspaper.

First write in the new shape. Mechanism: the option to reverse a move expires at the first act the new state performs that the old state cannot read, so the window is the pause between the change and its first consequence, and it closes with nobody deciding to close it. The migration can be rolled back until the new service writes its first record in a shape the old schema rejects; the merger is reversible until the first combined payroll; the new address until the first piece of mail arrives; the reorganization until the first hire into the new chart; the currency changeover until the first contract written in the new unit. Condition lost: a capability, the old state's ability to take over from here. Carrier: the first write, performed by the new state in the ordinary course of business and not a decision about the reversal at all. Threshold: the first record the old shape rejects. Tell: the closing act is routine business in the new state, never a choice about going back. Changed next move: the expand-and-contract shape, writing to both for a season so the old can still read, at the price of running two and of a season in which neither is the truth. Adds to pivot-invariants, which name the retained assets that make leaving cheap, the moment one of them is lost; and to undo-costs, which bills a reversal that remains possible, the reversal that stops being possible. Not Thawed to be ready, where readiness spoils the good, since here the new state's use closes the way back to the old.

Kept on the machine. Mechanism: the option is held open by a device or an upkeep whose own running accumulates a harm or whose stopping is one-way, so the deadline is the machine's and not the situation's. The patient on ECMO as a bridge to transplant becomes ineligible for the transplant the circuit was keeping her alive for, because bleeding, infection, and clotting rise with each week on circuit and centres set a duration past which candidacy is reviewed; the mothballed mine kept dry by pumps whose stopping floods the workings past reopening; the ship in the reserve fleet whose hull is kept by cathodic protection a budget line can end; the interim chief who has run the company past the point at which the search can bring in an outsider. Condition lost: a capability, the eligibility or the workings. Carrier: the bridge itself, its complication rate or its upkeep bill. Threshold: the centre's duration limit, the budget line, the point past which the interim cannot be replaced by an outsider. Tell: the clock is a harm nobody signs, not a date. Changed next move: a listing at the moment of cannulation, a search begun the day the interim was named, a decision to stop pumping taken while a sale was still possible, each treating the bridge's start as the option's deadline. The ECMO limits are centre practice and are simplified. Adds to lead-time-floors' Bridge, a degraded replacement priced by the hour, the bridge that ends the option it holds open. Not Standstill with a term, where the clock is a date the counterparty signs.

Standstill with a term. Mechanism: a pause taken to keep an option open is written on a paper that carries a date, so a situation that had no deadline acquires one, and the paper's renewal belongs to the counterparty, who now knows what the pause is worth to the holder. The tolling agreement stops the limitations clock the holder could have stopped alone by filing, and runs out in twelve months unless the adversary signs again; the negotiated leave of absence puts a date on a job that had none, extended only if the employer signs; the forbearance agreement holds the lender's foreclosure for ninety days; the furlough's recall rights run six months; the standstill in a takeover keeps the bidder from buying shares and ends on the day it says. Condition lost: a permission, the leave to remain in the paused state. Carrier: the pause's own instrument, the only clock in the situation the holder wrote. Threshold: the twelfth month, the ninetieth day, the sixth month, the day the standstill says. Tell: the renewal belongs to the adversary, who has learned the pause's value. Changed next move: the renewal asked for before the counterparty learns it is needed, or a pause written without a term, rarely granted; the Korean armistice is the exception with no renewal date and is still called temporary. The statutory pauses, the twelve weeks of the family-leave statute and the restraining order's fourteen days, are the same date without the mechanism, since the term is a rule's and the renewal belongs to a court or to no one, so the holder gets the deadline without paying the counterparty for it; those are runway-illusions' Stamp's clock. Adds to impasse-inventions' cooling-off right, reversibility offered as a chip, the bill the chip carries. Not lead-time-floors' No-shop, which serializes the search, since here the search is stopped and the stopping is what expires.
